spans.s: लौकायतिक m. A materialist, an atheist, a follower of Chārvāka.

लौकिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Terrestrial, mundane; 2. common, usual, ordinary, vulgar; 3. secular, temporal, not sacred, (op. to शास्त्रीय, वैदिक or आर्ष); 4. customary, K.S.vii.88; 5. used in ordinary language, (op. to वैदिक).
लौकिक (II) n. Any usage or general custom, वनौकसोऽपि संतो लौकिकज्ञा वयम् Sak.iv.

लौकिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Terrestrial, mundane; 2. common, usual, ordinary, vulgar; 3. secular, temporal, not sacred, (op. to शास्त्रीय, वैदिक or आर्ष); 4. customary, K.S.vii.88; 5. used in ordinary language, (op. to वैदिक).
लौक्य a. (f. क्या) 1. Worldly, mundane, terrestrial; 2. common, ordinary.
